output.surprise: There are some characters on the front of the box, and it says Dead or Alive 4... I was so taken aback that I had to cover my mouth to stop myself from bursting into laughter, completely caught off guard!
output.disgust: There are some grotesque characters on the front of the box, and it's written Dead or Alive 4... I had to put my hand over my mouth to suppress my laughter, my reaction was just pure disgust.
